outcome: Recall rate in congenital hypothyroidism screening
cohort: 22,383 newborn-mother pairs who underwent thyroid function tests during prenatal follow-up between 2014 and 2017 and had neonatal congenital hypothyroidism screening records
finding: Neonates of mothers with subclinical hypothyroidism had a higher recall rate in congenital hypothyroidism screening.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery increased the risk of recall in congenital hypothyroidism screening.
birth_weight: Low birth weight and large for gestational age infants included
